mentions.note: Belgrave veteran and UK W35 records 60m 7.40, 200m 24.42 at Birmingham Indoor Games

photos.c: Key lady - Christine Harrison-Bloomfield. Her 60m and 200m runs at the Birmingham Indoor Games were not only Belgrave veteran records, they were UK National W35 records as well. With her 7.40 and 24.42 she appears to have smashed the previous best marks held by J Kirby at 7.80 (1994) and 25.29 (1992).
